author: Netsi
notes: No third-party code. The capability calls Nominatim, whose responses are ODbL 1.0 data © OpenStreetMap contributors; that obligation is carried in the output's attribution field rather than in documentation, because it flows to whoever calls the capability. Recorded responses used as test fixtures are third-party data and are accounted for separately in tests/fixtures/provenance.json. Nominatim's usage policy caps callers at 1 request per second and requires an identifying User-Agent; both are reflected in the artifact.
